definitions.explanation: Excessive pride in one's appearance, achievements, or possessions, especially to impress others.

examples.japanese: {虚栄心|きょえいしん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{高価|こうか}→高価：02796_kouka⟧な⟦ブランド→ブランド：05221_burando⟧⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought expensive brand-name goods out of vanity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{虚栄心|きょえいしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
{虚栄心|きょえいしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{満|み}たす→満たす：09889_mitasu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To push oneself too hard to satisfy one's vanity.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{虚栄|きょえい}→虚栄：09464_kyoei⟧ (vanity, empty glory) + {心|しん} (heart, mind) → vain heart = vanity

WRITING:
- {虚|きょ} - empty, false
- {栄|えい} - glory, prosperity
- {心|しん} - heart, mind

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {虚栄心|きょえいしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ - to have strong vanity
- {虚栄心|きょえいしん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ - out of vanity
- {虚栄心|きょえいしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{満|み}たす→満たす：09889_mitasu⟧ - to satisfy one's vanity
- {虚栄心|きょえいしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧ - to abandon one's vanity

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{見栄|みえ}→見栄：06626_mie⟧ - show, pretense, vanity
- ⟦{見栄|みえ}を{張|は}る→見栄を張る：15322_miewoharu⟧ - to put on airs
- うぬぼれ - self-conceit
- ⟦{自尊心|じそんしん}→自尊心：11076_jisonshin⟧ - self-esteem (more neutral)

USAGE:
{虚栄心|きょえいしん} is almost always used negatively, suggesting empty or false pride focused on superficial appearances.
